What is a Process?
Your major goal divided into achievable steps
A process is a significant endeavor that requires smaller tasks to be accomplished. If one of those steps also expands, it becomes another process within it.
Break down challenging goals into simple, reachable milestones
If a task grows too large, easily turn it into a new process
Enjoy a dedicated General space for your everyday standalone tasks
Pause, complete, and reopen your processes whenever you need
Your Daily Tasks
Concrete actions with specific deadlines
Tasks are the practical steps of your process. Each task has a date and time deadline so you always know what to tackle next and when to finish.
Set your deadline and time quickly and effortlessly
Edit and adjust your tasks at any given moment
Assign an estimated budget if the activity requires purchases
We automatically calculate and track the time you invest
Focus Sessions
Dedicate focused time with peace and clarity
Start the timer on any task to move forward serenely. The app reliably tracks your focus in the background at your own rhythm.
The timer keeps running smoothly even when you leave the app
Jot down insights or reflections when completing each session
When completing a task, all accumulated time is fully preserved
Pause or cancel your active session freely whenever needed
